name: std::forward_list<T,Allocator>::end, std::forward_list<T,Allocator>::cend
intro:
Returns an iterator to the element following the last element of the forward_list.

This element acts as a placeholder; attempting to access it results in undefined behavior.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Iterator to the element following the last element.

examples.output:
1 2 4 8 16
Sum of nums: 31
First fruit: orange
forward_list 'empty' is indeed empty.

summary: Returns an iterator to the element following the last element of the forward_list.
